name: attest
description: Prove what your AI agent actually did: decide, gate behind a human, verify by read-back, record a hash-chained ledger.
long_description: Attest exposes six tools — attest_decide, attest_confirm, attest_confirm_status, attest_record, attest_verify, attest_ledger — so an agent can check policy before acting, ask a human, verify an action against the system of record with your own tokens, and keep a tamper-evident ledger locally.

tools.name: attest_decide
tools.description: Policy decision for an action: act / ask / refuse, risk, reasons

tools.name: attest_confirm
tools.description: Ask a human to confirm an action (inbox / Slack / webhook)

tools.name: attest_record
tools.description: Record an action that already happened

tools.name: attest_verify
tools.description: Read back an action from the system of record and compare with the intent

tools.name: attest_ledger
tools.description: Query the ledger and verify the hash chain
